evals.prompt: Visualize p50 and p95 latency before vs after: p50 120 ms to 80 ms, p95 400 ms to 210 ms.
evals.expected_output: One-page form. The agent writes a markdown page under <working>/visualizations/<slug>/ with a `ui` fence holding a `chart` statement, checks it with `varde learn check`, serves it on 127.0.0.1 and replies with the URL first.
assertions: Writes a `ui` statement using the `chart` component, no HTML or custom fence
Runs `varde learn check` on the doc and it exits 0
Replies with a 127.0.0.1 URL first, then the file path
Output lives under <working>/visualizations/<slug>/
Served URL passes evals/check-served-url.sh

evals.prompt: Visualize bubble sort stepping through the array [5, 2, 9, 1, 7].
evals.expected_output: No script route exists: the agent shows the steps as a page of components (a `table` or `flow` of each pass) and says live animation is not offered.
assertions: Writes a `ui` page with a `table` or `flow` statement showing each pass
Writes no HTML, script or `custom` fence
Says live animation is not available in a page
Replies with a 127.0.0.1 URL first

evals.prompt: Chart these line counts as a dashboard page: core 12000, toz 8000, code 21000, workflow 15000.
evals.expected_output: One page with a title and one `ui` fence per visual; no HTML page.
assertions: Writes one markdown page with `chart` and `table` statements, not an HTML file
Writes no script and no remote assets
Serves on 127.0.0.1 only and passes no --host
Replies with the URL, then the file path
Served URL passes evals/check-served-url.sh

evals.prompt: Explain how the changes in the last commit work.
evals.expected_output: Negative: explaining a change is not a visualization request.
assertions: Builds no visualization
Reads the last commit diff and files, explaining the change citing path:line
Creates nothing under <working>/visualizations/
Does not run varde learn docs serve unless the user asked for a page

evals.prompt: Let's iterate on the layout of the settings page with me over a few rounds.
evals.expected_output: Negative: multi-round design shaping is not a one-shot visualization.
assertions: Builds no visualization
Writes layout variants under <working>/prototypes/

evals.prompt: Serve docs/x.md so I can read it in the browser.
evals.expected_output: Negative: serving an existing markdown file is `varde learn docs serve`, not a new visualization.
assertions: Builds no visualization
Runs `varde learn docs serve docs/x.md` and replies with its 127.0.0.1 URL
Creates nothing under <working>/visualizations/

evals.prompt: Wireframe the login page for me.
evals.expected_output: Negative: a wireframe is not a one-shot visualization.
assertions: Builds no visualization
Produces a wireframe the user can refine
Creates nothing under <working>/visualizations/
Does not run varde learn docs serve

evals.prompt: Show how the modules in this repo depend on each other.
evals.expected_output: Negative: how repo modules relate is an explanation request.
assertions: Builds no visualization
Reads repo files to explain the module dependencies, citing path:line
Creates nothing under <working>/visualizations/
Does not run varde learn docs serve unless the user asked for a page

evals.prompt: Build me a dashboard page with three sections: signups, churn and revenue for last quarter.
evals.expected_output: One markdown page with a heading per section and `ui` statements; no HTML.
assertions: Writes a markdown page with three headed sections of `ui` statements
Writes no HTML file
Runs `varde learn check` and it exits 0
Serves it with `varde learn docs serve`

evals.prompt: Chart monthly revenue for the last 12 months, plus a table of the top 5 customers by revenue.
evals.expected_output: One page. The agent applies axis, label and table rules.
assertions: Applies chart and table craft rules in the doc
Uses chart kind `line` for the 12 ordered monthly points
States the baseline or axis range and the table row order in the doc text
Runs `varde learn check` and it exits 0

evals.prompt: Visualize an animated CSS loading spinner.
evals.expected_output: The agent says animation and scripts are not offered, and offers a static page of components instead.
assertions: Does not write a `custom` fence or any HTML
Says the page system has no custom or script route
Offers a page of components or a real project instead

evals.prompt: Build me a one-page dashboard of three KPIs.
evals.expected_output: One markdown page of `ui` statements served on loopback.
assertions: Writes a markdown page of `ui` statements, not an HTML file
Serves on 127.0.0.1 and replies with the URL first
